WITH type_counts AS (
    SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) as count_per_type
    FROM orders o
    INNER JOIN riskandmargin r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
    GROUP BY o.ordertune
),
avg_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(count_per_type) as avg_val
    FROM type_counts
),
above_avg_types AS (
    SELECT tc.count_per_type, (tc.count_per_type - ac.avg_val) as excess
    FROM type_counts tc
    CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
    WHERE tc.count_per_type > ac.avg_val
)
SELECT 
    AVG(count_per_type) as average_count,
    AVG(excess) as average_excess
FROM above_avg_types
